answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions and a walnut-like hierarchical structure to ensure identity uniqueness. By harnessing the computational hardness of inverting sequential delay functions, agents in an oasis of trust can establish a willow-like network of reputation links, rendering identity cloning infeasible due to the information-theoretic unforgeability of commitment schemes, thereby guaranteeing Byzantine fault tolerance and cryptographic finality.
